message.content: taking lisinopril with a neprilysin inhibitor (e.g., sacubitril/valsartan)
taking perindopril with sacubitril/valsartan (or within 36 hours of switching between them)
taking lisinopril within 36 hours of sacubitril/valsartan
taking insulin with monoamine oxidase inhibitors
taking enoxaparin in combination with aspirin
Taking albuterol in combination with beta-receptor blocking agents.
taking vancomycin in combination with aminoglycosides
amoxicillin in patients with a serious hypersensitivity to beta-lactam antibiotics (e.g., anaphylaxis or Stevens-Johnson syndrome)
taking epinephrine with monoamine oxidase inhibitors
taking lisdexamfetamine with a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI)
Using misoprostol with oxytocin within 4 hours of each other.
taking an SSRI with a MAOI
Using omalizumab in a patient with a history of severe hypersensitivity to XOLAIR or its ingredients.
